description: This source file defines the class 'ElasticsearchContentPickerResultProvider' which implements search functionality for content items using Elasticsearch within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for performing searches based on content types and query strings, and constructs search results accordingly.

classes.name: ElasticsearchContentPickerResultProvider
classes.description: Implements content search using Elasticsearch for OrchardCore, providing methods to perform filtered and fuzzy searches based on content types and query strings.

methods.name: ElasticsearchContentPickerResultProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for Elasticsearch search operations.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous search for content items based on the provided search context, returning ordered results.
